set -euo pipefail; PRE=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/parallax-eye-seam.XXXX); export T; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, os, cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual'); t=Path(os.environ['T']); W,H=1536,1024
rolls=['-25','-20','-15','-10','-05','+00','+05','+10','+15','+20','+25']; coeff=[1,1/3,-1/3,-1]
anchors=json.load(open(root/'rig2/augen_anker_exakt.json'))['werte']; blink=Image.open(root/'augen_blink/blink_000.png').convert('RGBA'); sw,sh=blink.size
print('BLINK_SIZE',sw,sh); print('SUBJECT_SHA',os.popen('sha256sum buehne.html').read().strip())
# Build pages using the exact accepted Chrome Canvas2D lighter primitive plus current live blink CSS geometry.
def page(r,A):
 d=f'kopf_rgba_parallax/gier_+00_nick_+00_roll_{r}'
 files=[next((root/d).glob(f'slice_{i}_*.png')).name for i in range(4)]
 off=anchors[str(int(r))]; dx,dy=off['dx_px'],off['dy_px']
 return f'''<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8><style>html,body{{margin:0;width:{W}px;height:{H}px;overflow:hidden;background:#303030}}canvas{{display:block}}</style><canvas id=c width={W} height={H}></canvas><script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d'); function I(u){{return new Promise((R,J)=>{{let i=new Image;i.onload=()=>R(i);i.onerror=J;i.src=u}})}};
(async()=>{{let ss=await Promise.all({json.dumps(files)}.map(n=>I('file://{root}/{d}/'+n))); let b=await I('file://{root}/augen_blink/blink_000.png'); x.clearRect(0,0,{W},{H}); x.globalCompositeOperation='lighter'; const co=[1,1/3,-1/3,-1]; for(let i=0;i<4;i++) x.drawImage(ss[i],co[i]*{A},0); x.globalCompositeOperation='source-over'; const pw={W}*.27, ph=pw*b.naturalHeight/b.naturalWidth, px={W}*.31, py={H}*.12; const ox=px+pw*.7038, oy=py+ph*2.4132; x.save(); x.translate({dx},{dy}); x.translate(ox,oy); x.rotate(({int(r)})*Math.PI/180); x.translate(-ox,-oy); x.drawImage(b,px,py,pw,ph); x.restore(); document.title='READY';}})();</script>'''
# transformed blink-alpha mask matching CSS transform list translate() rotate() + transform-origin.
pw=W*.27; ph=pw*sh/sw; px=W*.31; py=H*.12
small=cv2.resize(np.array(blink)[:,:,3],(round(pw),round(ph)),interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
base=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); ix,iy=round(px),round(py); hh,ww=small.shape; base[iy:iy+hh,ix:ix+ww]=small[:min(hh,H-iy),:min(ww,W-ix)]
for r in rolls:
 for A in (0,0.25):
  p=t/f'{r}_{A}.html'; p.write_text(page(r,A)); out=t/f'{r}_{A}.png'
  cmd=['/usr/bin/google-chrome','--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--allow-file-access-from-files','--hide-scrollbars',f'--window-size={W},{H}','--virtual-time-budget=2500',f'--screenshot={out}',f'file://{p}']
  q=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=15); assert q.returncode==0 and out.exists(),(r,A,q.returncode)
 rows=[]
 for r in rolls:
  a=cv2.imread(str(t/f'{r}_0.png')); v=cv2.imread(str(t/f'{r}_0.25.png')); assert a is not None and v is not None and a.shape[:2]==(H,W)
  off=anchors[str(int(r))]; ox=px+pw*.7038; oy=py+ph*2.4132
  # cv2 positive angle is CCW in image coordinates; browser positive CSS is clockwise visually, so use -roll.
  M=cv2.getRotationMatrix2D((ox,oy),-int(r),1.0); M[0,2]+=off['dx_px']; M[1,2]+=off['dy_px']; m=cv2.warpAffine(base,M,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0)
  sup=m>=16; dil=cv2.dilate(sup.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((13,13),np.uint8)).astype(bool); ero=cv2.erode(sup.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((9,9),np.uint8)).astype(bool); ring=dil & ~ero; outer=dil & ~sup
  g0=cv2.cvtColor(a,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32); g1=cv2.cvtColor(v,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
  sx0=cv2.Sobel(g0,cv2.CV_32F,1,0,ksize=3); sy0=cv2.Sobel(g0,cv2.CV_32F,0,1,ksize=3); sx1=cv2.Sobel(g1,cv2.CV_32F,1,0,ksize=3); sy1=cv2.Sobel(g1,cv2.CV_32F,0,1,ksize=3); e0=np.hypot(sx0,sy0); e1=np.hypot(sx1,sy1)
  d=np.abs(v.astype(np.int16)-a.astype(np.int16)).mean(axis=2)
  def mean(z,sel): return float(z[sel].mean()) if sel.any() else 0
  def q(z,sel,p): return float(np.quantile(z[sel],p)) if sel.any() else 0
  rec={'roll':r,'ring_diff_mae':mean(d,ring),'ring_diff_p99':q(d,ring,.99),'outer_diff_mae':mean(d,outer),'core_diff_mae':mean(d,sup),'ring_edge_ratio':mean(e1,ring)/(mean(e0,ring)+1e-6),'ring_edge_p99_ratio':q(e1,ring,.99)/(q(e0,ring,.99)+1e-6),'mask_px':int(sup.sum())}; rows.append(rec)
  print('ROLL',r,'ring_mae',f"{rec['ring_diff_mae']:.4f}",'ring_p99',f"{rec['ring_diff_p99']:.4f}",'outer_mae',f"{rec['outer_diff_mae']:.4f}",'core_mae',f"{rec['core_diff_mae']:.4f}",'edge_ratio',f"{rec['ring_edge_ratio']:.5f}",'edge_p99_ratio',f"{rec['ring_edge_p99_ratio']:.5f}",'mask',rec['mask_px'])
print('WORST',json.dumps({'max_ring_mae':max(x['ring_diff_mae'] for x in rows),'max_ring_p99':max(x['ring_diff_p99'] for x in rows),'max_outer_mae':max(x['outer_diff_mae'] for x in rows),'max_core_mae':max(x['core_diff_mae'] for x in rows),'ring_edge_ratio_range':[min(x['ring_edge_ratio'] for x in rows),max(x['ring_edge_ratio'] for x in rows)],'ring_edge_p99_ratio_range':[min(x['ring_edge_p99_ratio'] for x in rows),max(x['ring_edge_p99_ratio'] for x in rows)]},sort_keys=True))
PY
